title: EnzSub: substrate supervision reorganizes enzyme representations by catalytic identity
description: Source code and experiment configurations for enzyme-domain continued pre-training (CPT), substrate-aware training (SUB), representation analyses and downstream numerical evaluations reported in the accompanying manuscript. The repository contains the training and evaluation pipeline, fixed data splits, experiment configuration files and reproduction instructions.
